title: Counit formula for the inverse tensor–Hom adjunction chain
statement:
Fix the scheme and four coefficient-stage conventions of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes with the exceptional adjunction of [fix-prop-adjunctions]. Let $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ and $N\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$. Use the derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the restricted tensor–Hom adjunction [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-adjunctions], and projection isomorphism [fix-prop-projection-formula], with the projection map of [def-exchange-projection]. Put
$$C=Rf_!M,\quad L_N=R\mathcal Hom_X(M,Rf^!N),\quad A_N=Rf_*L_N,\quad B_N=R\mathcal Hom_Y(C,N).$$
Write $\varepsilon_{L_N}:Lf^*A_N\to L_N$ and $\mu_N:Rf_!Rf^!N\to N$ for the ordinary and exceptional counits, and $P_T:C\otimes^LT\to Rf_!(M\otimes^LLf^*T)$ for projection. Define
$$p_N=\mu_N\circ Rf_!\bigl(\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N}\circ(1_M\otimes\varepsilon_{L_N})\bigr)\circ P_{A_N}.$$
For every $T\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$ and $t:T\to A_N$, the composite Hom bijection
$$\Phi_T^N:\operatorname{Hom}_Y(T,A_N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_X(Lf^*T,L_N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_X(M\otimes^LLf^*T,Rf^!N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_Y(Rf_!(M\otimes^LLf^*T),N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_Y(C\otimes^LT,N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_Y(T,B_N)$$
satisfies $\Phi_T^N(t)=\operatorname{curry}(p_N)\circ t$. Here the fourth bijection precomposes with $P_T$, and currying/evaluation use the chosen tensor–Hom adjunction as in [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws]. These formulas are natural in both $T$ and $N$. Integral operations are completed; field operations use rationalization and common finite stages.
